1. Minimize the candidate to a single deterministic solve function and spend complexity on the proof envelope instead.
2. The mechanism returns the supplied scalar unchanged while the harness owns comparison, timing, and receipt storage.
3. Separating mechanism from proof prevents candidate prose from declaring its own success.
4. The main risk is allowing the generated implementation to influence test selection or baseline interpretation.
5. Use an independent test author and fail closed on any output, timeout, memory, process, or path-limit violation.
6. Confidence: 0.77
